reviews.name: Shayne Cook
reviews.text: Eric and his team were great! Super friendly, timely and organized. They even were patient enough to let the kids get involved on throwing some of the chips.

reviews.name: Eyonda Williams
reviews.text: Fantastic work on our garage floors! The team was professional, kind, and easy to work with. We’re very pleased with how everything turned out and would happily recommend them

reviews.name: Curt Shipley
reviews.text: Show Me Epoxy came on the day and time promised. The job was completed in the amount of time they promised. Excellent craftsmanship. They show a lot of pride in their work. Well done!

reviews.name: Premier Advantage
reviews.text:
We had an absolutely wonderful experience with Eric at Show Me Epoxy! We originally hired another company, but they never showed up. I called Eric on a Sunday, and he answered the phone and was willing to help us when we really needed it.
From start to finish, Eric was fantastic. He explained exactly what he was going to do, answered all of our questions, kept everything clean, and delivered exactly what he promised. Even better, he finished the job a full day sooner than he originally quoted!
We also found Eric to be much more affordable than the other companies we received quotes from, without sacrificing quality whatsoever. The workmanship is fantastic, and his attention to detail really shows.
Awesome guy, fantastic quality, and even better customer service! We highly recommend Eric and Show Me Epoxy. If you're looking for someone who is dependable, professional, honest, and does an amazing job, look no further!

Before and after pics listed on just one of the bathrooms he did.

reviews.name: C B
reviews.text: I am absolutely thrilled with my new epoxy patio floor! Eric and his crew took our drab, boring floor and made it absolutely beautiful. They did an excellent job from start to finish. It is clear that they are incredibly passionate about the work they do, and it shows in the flawless quality of the final result. If you want a team that takes genuine pride in their craftsmanship, look no further than Show Me Epoxy!!!

reviews.name: Amber Rudkin
reviews.text:
From start to finish these guys worked hard and gave my home an AMAZING floor. Easy to work with, great individuals and completely dedicated to making sure you enjoy your outcome. I would definitely recommend them if you are looking into epoxy floors. Whether it’s a garage or your entire home like we did, you won’t be disappointed…

Forever thankful for your hard work dedication and amazing outcome.. Thank you guys!!

reviews.name: Larry Byars
reviews.text: Eric and the crew are top notch.

reviews.name: T Wells
reviews.text: Eric and his team were great to work with. They removed our DIY kit that was chipping and pulling off and replaced it with a great product at a reasonable cost. When I thought there was an issue Eric immediately came back and looked at it. I would highly recommend him and his team on any project. The best part is dealing directly with Eric the owner and not a salesmen.

reviews.name: s s
reviews.text:
What a beautiful floor!
Thank you so much!
Showed up when they said and finished that day.

reviews.name: Tanya Toebben
reviews.text: Huge shout out to Show Me Epoxy! They completely transformed our sad carport floor into a space that we could actually hang out on instead of just park our car. Their pricing was very fair, communication was easy, and the crew was courteous with our property. We definitely recommend them if your concrete needs some TLC!

reviews.name: Paula McClanahan
reviews.text: Eric and the crew members performed an exceptional job on our garage floor. The time spent to prepare the floor was appreciated and resulted in a fabulous finish. The professionalism of the crew along with a timely overall completion was outstanding. The garage floor looks great. Thanks Eric and team!

reviews.name: russ huhmann
reviews.text:
Eric and team were great to work with - friendly and professional with reasonable pricing.
They also worked a long 12 hour day to complete two separate projects (garage and elevated deck) to meet our needs.

reviews.name: Peggy Crawford
reviews.text: I could not be more pleased with how my garage turned out. Outstanding attention to detail.

reviews.name: Chad Miller
reviews.text:
I can't say enough about what an amazing job Show Me Epoxy did on resurfacing out outdoor concrete patio. It is a stunning transformation. Eric and his crew were extremely professional, courteous, and showed up exactly when he said they would. Eric even got it done on a Sunday so when we came to the lake, it would be done. The price was great and the workmanship even greater. If you want to resurface concrete, I definitely recommend Show Me Epoxy.
Chad Miller

reviews.name: Payton Kempker
reviews.text: They do amazing work and are great people and they have good prices

reviews.name: Chuck Lawson
reviews.text: Eric is no joke! They take their work very seriously and make sure you are very aware of their 5-year warranty and how he stands by his team's work. The garage floor is amazing. I have heard so many stories of DYI people trying to do their own to supposedly save some money. Trust me, as an engineer myself, I assure you it has to be done properly to last. My only regret is not getting this done sooner. You will absolutely be treated well with a professional job. Great work Eric and Team...THANK YOU!

reviews.name: Gale
reviews.text: Great job done, floor looks great, staff kind and courteous.

reviews.name: Barbara Wilson
reviews.text: I was very excited to finally see the finished porch. There was an issue with a faulty product but Eric didn’t give up. He came back as many times as necessary to make sure the end product was as promised. He is a perfectionist and willing to do what is necessary to make the customer happy with the end product. Thank you Eric.

reviews.name: Joel Smith
reviews.text: Eric and team are amazing! Definitely the best in Missouri for epoxy floors!

reviews.name: michael bohannon
reviews.text: Eric and his crew were very easy to work with, they installed my new garage flooring on Sunday of all days, because it worked out best for both of us. The price is reasonable for the quality of work. I am very pleased with the outcome. After speaking with Eric the owner, about warranty he stands behind his product, he indicated any issue with the floor just contact him and he will make it right.

reviews.name: Vicky Toebben
reviews.text: Thank you Show Me Epoxy for our stunning new garage floor! It's more than I could have imagined. Turned out perfect! Highly recommend these guys for your next flooring needs!
